title: Metadata-backed lexical place-identity proof
summary: Use a public POI alias pack as an asymmetric positive identity witness: a unique scene-text proof may authorize or veto a requested place, while absent text remains UNKNOWN and falls back to appearance.

mechanisms.name: Asymmetric metadata-plus-text identity join
mechanisms.description: Match OCR line windows to public POI aliases with a Development-frozen score and uniqueness margin. A proof accepts only its named entity and rejects other requests; no proof preserves the frozen appearance decision instead of emitting NONE.
mechanisms.limitations: The first fresh test was perfectly precise on five proofs but covered only two of four source-labeled identity-bearing views; fixed digital tiling added no proof. The branch is not yet generally available.
